lead.headline: Cherry Blossom leads the champ. With a hole at WR.
lead.dek: Cherry Blossom took a 71.72 to 57.7 lead into the weekend and is still the underdog. Parker Washington is Out, Tee Higgins is Questionable, and Maye I touch your TDs? has eight starters left, a new quarterback and a 65% win probability.
lead.pull: Cherry Blossom leads by 14.02 and is a 35% underdog. That isn’t a lead. That’s a head start in the wrong race.
body: I’ve covered Cherry Blossom all season, and this is the most Cherry Blossom scoreboard possible: winning on paper, losing in the math. Friday’s game added 20.8 more to the pile, Jonah Coleman 15.2 out of the FLEX and Jaylen Warren 5.6, and the lead over the defending champ is now 71.72 to 57.7. Bo Nix scored 3.46 on the bench. That call was right.

Here’s the problem. Cherry Blossom has spent its weekend almost entirely. Five starters remain: Trevor Lawrence, Christian McCaffrey, Tee Higgins, Baltimore Ravens D/ST and Parker Washington, who was ruled Out with a shoulder and now projects 0.0. Those five project for 60.8. Maye I touch your TDs? has eight starters still to play, projecting for 101.09. Live projection: Maye 158.79, Cherry Blossom 146.84. Win probability: 65% to 35%. Yesterday it was 45.1% Maye.

So: what will Cherry Blossom do at wide receiver? Two slots, one healthy bench receiver. Tre Tucker (7.48) can plug Washington’s hole, but then Higgins (16.26, Questionable, hamstring) has no understudy when Cincinnati kicks off at Sun 10:00 AM. The cleaner answer is on the wire, in Washington’s own building: Jakobi Meyers projects 12.74, Josh Cameron 9.66, Brian Thomas Jr. 7.6, and all three are unrostered. Add Meyers for Washington, keep Tucker in the pocket for Higgins. That’s two answers for two questions.

Maye, meanwhile, spent Friday rebuilding on the fly. Brock Purdy went from Questionable to Out, and at Fri 4:45 PM this front office added Fernando Mendoza (12.68) and slid him into the QB slot, dropping an injured A.J. Brown to make room. Earlier, at Fri 10:45 AM, Kyle Pitts Sr. (8.19) came in for Michael Mayer. The one quibble: Deshaun Watson is still on the wire at 15.49, plays in the same Sun 5:20 PM game as Mendoza, and projects 2.81 higher. Maye has until kickoff to change its mind.

Stakes are real on both sides. Maye is 3-8 and holds the last playoff spot at 70.8% odds, with Santa Clara’s Finest (25.7%) and Big Stric Energy (3.5%) behind it. Cherry Blossom is 6-5 and locked in at 100%, playing for seeding. One team is playing for its season; the other is playing for a better parking spot.

My read: Maye’s eight-starter Sunday, led by Bucky Irving (20.62) and Zay Flowers (16.49), is the reason the math leans its way. Cherry Blossom can narrow that by filling the hole before 10 a.m. Sunday. Fill it, and this is a game. Don’t, and 14.02 points evaporate by the late window.

quick_hits.headline: The Finest lost Tuten. The wire has his replacement.
quick_hits.body: Bhayshul Tuten was ruled Out with an ankle, and Santa Clara’s Finest have no running back on the bench who hasn’t already played: Blake Corum’s 28.5 came Thursday. Their win probability against Bad things man bad things slid from 49.7% to 37.2%. The fix is obvious and free: Chris Rodriguez Jr., Tuten’s teammate, is unrostered and now projects 17.26. Bad things leads 36.4 to 26.2; with Rodriguez, this is still the upset of the weekend.

quick_hits.headline: What will AB81 do at quarterback?
quick_hits.body: Justin Herbert is now Out with a concussion and still in AB81’s QB slot. Sam Darnold (15.84) is the obvious answer and plays Sun 1:25 PM. As set, AB81 projects 118.74 and Big Stric Energy 146.76; with the right calls AB81 is at 150.84 and 80.4% to win. Assume the swap gets made. It is the only thing keeping this from being an upset alert of its own.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 kept Dowdle. Dowdle got 6.4.
quick_hits.body: AB81 made its noon call Friday by not making one: Rico Dowdle (6.4) and Germie Bernard (6.8) stayed in, George Kittle stayed on the bench. That’s 13.2 banked and a 34.3 to 24.44 lead over Big Stric. Kittle (10.86) can still help at tight end over Mark Andrews (8.04), a 2.82-point upgrade, and both play Sunday.

quick_hits.headline: Bad things’ McMillan clock hits 10 a.m. Sunday
quick_hits.body: Tetairoa McMillan (14.06) is still Questionable with a foot and doesn’t play until Mon 5:15 PM. Jordyn Tyson (11.81) locks at Sun 10:00 AM and Antonio Williams (9.57) at Sun 1:25 PM. Bad things is 62.8% to win; I’d ride McMillan only if there’s good news before Williams locks.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski is still at 184.64. Still Saturday.
quick_hits.body: Chase Brown, Chris Olave and San Francisco 49ers D/ST are all that’s left for Poochinski, and it’s already 98% to win. deeboliciouskins needs 126.58 and projects 165.53 to Poochinski’s 221.23. The only drama is whether 184.64 is a floor or a ceiling.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric’s bench outscored its FLEX
quick_hits.body: DK Metcalf put up 12.6 Friday on Big Stric’s bench, on a 6.86 projection. Nobody would have started him. Rashee Rice scored 3.9 in the FLEX. Big Stric trails 34.3 to 24.44 with Geno Smith, Ashton Jeanty, Nico Collins and Justin Jefferson to come, 19.6% to win and 3.5% to make the playoffs.

w12-m1.headline: AB81, once Darnold goes in
w12-m1.blurb: AB81 leads 34.3 to 24.44 and is 80.4% to win with Darnold starting. Herbert is Out and still in the lineup; the call is due Sun 1:25 PM. Big Stric needs Jefferson and Collins to go off.

w12-m2.headline: The leader is the underdog
w12-m2.blurb: Cherry Blossom 71.72, Maye 57.7. Maye has eight starters left to Cherry Blossom’s five, one of which is Out. 65% Maye.

w12-m3.headline: Poochinski, by Thanksgiving
w12-m3.blurb: 184.64 to 58.06, 98% Poochinski. deeboliciouskins’ seven starters project for 103.78.

w12-m4.headline: The Finest need Rodriguez
w12-m4.blurb: Bad things leads 36.4 to 26.2 and is 62.8% to win. The Finest have a 0.0 at RB until they add Chris Rodriguez Jr. (17.26). Bad things has McMillan’s Monday question.

w12-r4-s5.headline: Cherry Blossom at WR: go get Jakobi Meyers
w12-r4-s5.blurb: Parker Washington is Out and there’s no spare receiver once Tucker covers Higgins. Jakobi Meyers (12.74) is unrostered and plays Sun 10:00 AM. Josh Cameron (9.66) is the fallback.

w12-r4-s4.headline: Cherry Blossom at WR: Higgins, with Tucker behind him
w12-r4-s4.blurb: Higgins (16.26, Questionable, hamstring) kicks off Sun 10:00 AM, so that’s the real clock. Tucker (7.48) is the healthy floor.

w12-r8-s0.headline: AB81 at QB: Darnold, obviously
w12-r8-s0.blurb: Herbert is Out. Darnold projects 15.84 and plays Sun 1:25 PM.

w12-r5-s4.headline: Bad things at WR: McMillan or Tyson?
w12-r5-s4.blurb: McMillan (14.06) is Questionable and plays Monday. Tyson (11.81) locks Sun 10:00 AM, Williams (9.57) Sun 1:25 PM. Williams is the last exit.

w12-r7-s3.headline: The Finest at RB: Rodriguez, 17.26
w12-r7-s3.blurb: Tuten is Out and the bench has nothing left. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is unrostered and projects 17.26 at Sun 10:00 AM.

w12-r3-s0.headline: Maye made its QB call: Mendoza in
w12-r3-s0.blurb: Purdy went to Out; Fernando Mendoza (12.68) is in. Deshaun Watson (15.49) is still on the wire in the same game.
